messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#87654321 — inference-alloc-failures (priority: P1). Auto-escalation to SRE after 30s. links: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/87654321 :rotating_light:
jesse: Acked on-call (taking). Seeing high 5xx rate from embedder pool in us-west-2.
maria: Thanks — any customer impact yet?
jesse: Yes — 2 customer requests failed in last 2 mins, 5xx spike to ~14% on /v1/embeddings. Affected tenants: internal-smoke + vendor-test.
sre-olivia: On it. Spinning up temporary dedicated pool (dedicated-ephemeral-1) to absorb traffic, will reroute. Running: `rbctl pool create --profile=embedder-small --region=us-west-2 --ephemeral`
kevin: FYI I pushed a traffic rule to route retries to the dedicated pool for error_code=ALLOC_FAIL: `route add --if error=ALLOC_FAIL --to pool:dedicated-ephemeral-1`
jesse: Confirming reroute. Traffic to legacy pool dropping from 100% -> 22% now. 5xx rate is trending down to ~4% but still noisy.
maria: Can we get a short customer-facing note? I can ping support if we have ETA.
sre-olivia: ETA for full cold-start: ~3m for shards to be ready. Creating bridge for logs: https://meet.company.com/bridge/bridge-4532
incident-bot: PD#87654321 updated: acknowledged by jesse, status -> investigating. Escalation timer paused.
kevin: Quick mitigation: rolled back latest model variant on legacy pool (deployed 12:03 UTC). Command: `deploy rollback model:embed-v3 -> embed-v2` — this reduced allocation churn.
jesse: After rollback + reroute: error_rate 14% -> 1.1% over 2m. Latency stable. Marking partial mitigation.
maria: Support notified customers in the affected orgs with a brief: "We observed transient failures against the embeddings endpoint; routing changes reduced errors. We'll follow up with root cause."
sre-olivia: Doing post-incident checklist: capture k-v cache eviction logs, kernel OOMs, and autoscaler events. Will attach runbook snippet in the ticket.
jesse: Handing back ownership to SRE for postmortem and RCA. @sre-olivia do you want to own the follow-up? :point_down:
sre-olivia: I’ll own the RCA and next steps. Assigning PD incident to SRE lead and opening an RCA ticket: https://jira.company.com/browse/RCA-4321
kevin: Leaving a note — we should add a circuit-breaker and soft-eviction buffer to the embedder profile to avoid allocation thundering on model swaps.
maria: Great. Final update for this thread: customer impact limited, mitigation applied, SRE owning postmortem. Closing alert once RCA ticket created. :white_check_mark:
